stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: Three new boats, three Boat copies?

stations.title: Boat
stations.text: Name, seats, the day fare, a description

stations.title: Your boat kinds
stations.gap: Every new kind starts from zero

captions: Lanternquay has new kinds of boat, and Ossian does not want Boat copied for each.
Today each new kind would be Boat written out again, with every fix made three times.
You write three classes that extend Boat: one adds bikes, one a fare, one a hirer.
Now each new kind is a Boat, and adds or changes only its own part.
extends, super and @Override. Next: a parent that is never made by itself.
